newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll acquires Voith German foundry.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll acquires Voith German foundry.

text.p: Swiss technology group Von Roll Holding AG said on Wednesday it would acquire 70 percent of J.M. Voith GmbH's foundry activities in Heidenhem, Germany following approval by the German cartel authorities.
Von Roll said in a statement that it would take over the operational leadership of the activities this month and the new company would be named Von Roll Voith Guss GmbH.
Voith will retain the remaining 30 percent of the foundry.
The acquisition is part of Von Roll's strategy of focusing and strengthening its core activities. The foundry will mainly produce medium to large cast iron products with a weight of up to 105 tonnes.
The Voith foundry had 1995 sales of 36 million Swiss francs compared with Von Rolls' foundry sales of 200 million.
